findings.message: F1 SOURCES / coverage grounding. VERIFIED RESOLVED: coverage/unit-03.md row for U3-03 (Linear inequalities) now cites no-source-u3-3 and is documented under ## Unverifiable sources with open gap G-2026-29 per D-2026-0001; U3-04 openstax row was dropped (ncm and gula2025 rows document U3-04); sources/unit-03.md Supports cell for openstax-prealgebra now correctly lists U3-01, U3-02, U3-05.

F2 ASSESSMENT / conflicting marking criteria. VERIFIED RESOLVED: unit-assessment.mdx:180-182 (RRQ-8 model answer) now explicitly attributes the substitution check to the decide step ("1 - check assigned to decide"), matching topic-03.mdx:59 where the worked example performs the substitution check under step 4 "Decide and check".

F3 PEDAGOGY / arithmetic inconsistency in activity example. VERIFIED RESOLVED: topic-02.mdx:87-89 (Activity: The fare desk) model situation now gives "150 rupees for a 4-km trip on the 50-plus-25 rate" (50 + 25 x 4 = 150), which is internally consistent.

F4 ASSESSMENT / MCQ key concentration. 8 of 10 MCQ correct options are "b" (unit-assessment.mdx:152-161; MCQ-1 and MCQ-6 are "a"; none at "c" or "d"). All keys verified correct against independent solving, but a test-wise learner marking only b scores 8/10. Redistribute correct options across a-d at the next bank revision.

F5 ASSESSMENT / Bloom tag inconsistency. MCQ-1 (unit-assessment.mdx:36) is tagged Remember, but the identical task in topic-01.mdx:93 (CYU-1) is tagged Apply, and the thinking actually required (applying the growth rule four times to generate terms) is Apply. Align the tags.

F6 PEDAGOGY / repeated problem. The tutor problem (250 + 400s = 2,650) appears three times: topic-02.mdx:96-98 (CYU-2), topic-03.mdx:53-59 (worked example) and topic-03.mdx:82-83 (CYU-2, verbatim). The repetition reduces practice value and makes two check-your-understanding items predictable from the worked example. Vary one instance numbers or context in a future revision.

F7 SOURCES / Supports-cell precision. VERIFIED RESOLVED: sources/unit-03.md:11 now states gula2025 supports "U3-04: numeracy tasks as their own category, inspiring transfer between concrete and abstract thinking", accurately reflecting what the ERIC record documents without claiming matchsticks.

F8 AUTHORITY / SLO scheme description. course-overview.mdx:57-58 describes the reference scheme as "SLO:GQUR-300-1-1 through SLO:GQUR-300-5-5 (course outcome, then unit)", but in every unit front matter the second number repeats the course outcome. The substance is correct; the parenthetical misdescribes the scheme (course-level file, not unit-03 specific).

F9 PROCESS / manifest binding gap for two source excerpts. This unit prepared manifest binds only sources/texts/gula2025.md; sources/texts/ncm.md and sources/texts/openstax-prealgebra.md are outside the bound set because citedKeysFor only recognises keys containing a 4-digit year. Both were verified this review.

F10 ACCESSIBILITY / visual and print inspection. Visual and accessibility criteria verified programmatically via static layout analysis, SVG text geometry measurement (scripts/measure-figure-text.mjs exit 0), and sharp PNG rasterizations with resolved palette variables, saved as evidence.

F11 READABILITY / multiplication sign. "x" is used as a multiplication sign in prose and figures while MCQ-6 uses x as a variable ("5x - 7 > 18"). For a fresher meeting algebra for the first time the two uses can collide. Consider multiplication dot or explicit wording in a later revision.
